value.name: notarize and secure affidavits
value.description: The affidavits are notarized and locked into the firm's overnight safe, completing the night's legal work.
evidence: By the time the affidavits were notarized and locked into the firm's overnight safe

value.name: escort Lucia and Rosa to cab
value.description: Asha walks Lucia and Rosa to the curb and sees them off in a cab.
evidence: Asha walked Lucia and Rosa to the curb

value.name: Lucia boards cab with unresolved burden
value.description: Lucia settles into the back seat clutching her cardigan, suggesting emotional strain or reluctance.
evidence: watching Lucia settle into the back seat with the cardigan bunched in her lap like something she could not yet put down

value.name: Rosa comforts Lucia in cab
value.description: Rosa sits beside Lucia and places a reassuring hand on her knee as they leave.
evidence: Rosa got in beside her without a word and laid a hand flat on Lucia's knee

value.name: Asha walks home alone
value.description: Asha returns home alone after the cab departs, carrying the night's emotional residue with her.
evidence: Asha walked the four blocks home alone with the taste of the night still in her mouth

value.name: discover urgent message from sister
value.description: Inside her apartment, Asha finds a blinking message light indicating her sister has called about trouble at the group home involving their mother.
evidence: the message light on the landline was blinking the slow double pulse her sister used when something at the group home had gone wrong with their mother again

value.name: listen to message twice
value.description: Asha stands in the dark hallway and listens to the message twice, absorbing the bad news.
evidence: She stood in the dark hallway with her coat still on and listened to the message twice

value.name: set aside family crisis
value.description: Asha recognizes that the Serrano file is finished for the night but her family crisis is no longer something she can ignore.
evidence: The Serrano file was sealed for the night; the other thing she had been holding at arm's length for months was not.

value.name: leave apartment to respond
value.description: Without sitting down, Asha decides to leave immediately after hearing the message.
evidence: then turned in the dark hallway and went back out the way she had come

value.name: drive away at night
value.description: Asha heads to the garage, starts her car, and prepares to drive off at 11:23.
evidence: The garage two blocks over smelled of wet concrete and old exhaust, and her car started on the first turn of the key, the dashboard clock reading eleven-twenty-three
